data.one_liner: Property-based testing library for Dart, integrating with package:test.
data.what_it_does: It lets you define properties that are automatically tested with random data, supports custom exploration, and offers stateful testing for systems that change over time.
use_when: Writing property-based tests for Dart code
Testing stateful systems like databases or UI state machines
Integrating tests into existing package:test suites
avoid_when: Replacing unit tests that only check specific inputs
Using in projects that require code generation or declarative UI patterns
weaknesses: Limited to Dart (no Flutter widgets integration)
Requires manual setup of stateful behaviors
data.setup_notes: Add as dev_dependency and import 'package:kiri_check/kiri_check.dart'; no build_runner needed
